name: paranormalmusings
description: Root scripts, so a host that builds from the repository root can build either app without a subdirectory setting.

scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix paranormalmusings-frontend install && npm --prefix paranormalmusings-frontend run build
scripts.build:frontend-1: npm --prefix paranormalmusings-frontend-1 install && npm --prefix paranormalmusings-frontend-1 run build
scripts.build:admin: npm --prefix paranormalmusings-admin install && npm --prefix paranormalmusings-admin run build
